items.title: Renew City of Charleston business license
items.authority: City of Charleston Revenue Collections Division
items.description: Business licenses expire April 30 each year and are renewed on the previous year's gross income; the city's page gives the fee as payable by May 31 with penalties after June 30.

items.title: Renew City of Columbia business license
items.authority: City of Columbia Business Licenses Division
items.description: Business licenses expire April 30 each year; a 5% penalty accrues per month from May 1.
